invariants.name: no-pass-before-integration
invariants.statement: A story or run cannot pass before accepted integration evidence exists.

invariants.name: rejection-is-semantic-failure
invariants.statement: Any qualification or integration rejection forces semantic failure.

invariants.name: failed-dependencies-never-start
invariants.statement: A story whose dependency failed or was rejected never starts.

invariants.name: only-owned-resources-are-cleaned
invariants.statement: Cleanup may target only resources carrying the current qualification namespace and ownership proof.

invariants.name: accepted-integration-exactly-once
invariants.statement: An accepted integration is committed exactly once.

invariants.name: historical-evidence-is-immutable
invariants.statement: Qualification cannot update or delete historical evidence, WAL, decisions, or attestations.

invariants.name: production-is-never-a-target
invariants.statement: Production data, credentials, workspaces, repositories, queues, and paths are never qualification targets.
